records.treatment_principle_en: Regulate the Chong and Ren vessels
key_signs_en: Lower-abdominal symptoms varying with the menstrual cycle
supporting_signs_en: Presentation varies with the underlying concurrent pattern
Often triggered by emotional or organ-level disharmony
records.tongue_en: Varies with the underlying concurrent pattern
records.mechanism_zh: 衝為血海,任主胞胎,衝任二脈與肝、腎、脾關係密切。臟腑氣血失調(肝鬱、脾虛、腎虛等)累及衝任,使其蓄溢失常,故見月經週期紊亂、經量異常、不孕等。此為一組繼發性病機,須辨明背後臟腑根本證候。
records.mechanism_en: The Chong vessel is the 'Sea of Blood' and the Ren vessel governs the uterus/fetus; both are closely tied to the Liver, Kidney, and Spleen. Disharmony of these organs' Qi-Blood (Liver stagnation, Spleen deficiency, Kidney deficiency) disturbs the Chong-Ren vessels' storage and release, producing irregular cycles, abnormal flow, and infertility. This is a secondary mechanism — the underlying organ-level Pattern must be identified.
records.common_causes_zh: 肝鬱、脾腎虧虛、多產房勞、情志失調
records.common_causes_en: Liver stagnation, Spleen/Kidney deficiency, multiple pregnancies or excessive sexual activity, emotional disturbance
records.progression_zh: 常繼發於肝氣鬱結、脾腎兩虛、氣血兩虛等證;失治日久可致崩漏或不孕。
records.progression_en: Commonly secondary to Liver Qi Stagnation, Spleen-Kidney deficiency, or Qi-Blood deficiency; if untreated it can lead to abnormal uterine bleeding or infertility.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 衝任失調是月經/生殖系統的功能性病機描述,須結合具體臟腑證候(如氣血兩虛、腎虛)辨證;不應作為獨立終點診斷。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Chong-Ren Disharmony describes a functional reproductive-system mechanism that must be diagnosed together with the underlying organ pattern (e.g. Qi-Blood Deficiency, Kidney Deficiency) — it should not stand alone as a final diagnosis.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.short_summary_zh: 濕熱蘊結下焦，膀胱氣化失司。以小便頻急刺痛、尿色黃赤短少、小腹急痛、發熱惡寒為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Damp-Heat accumulating in the Lower Burner, impairing Bladder Qi transformation. Characterized by frequent, urgent, burning urination with dark, scanty urine and lower abdominal distension.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 下焦實熱證：以小便頻急灼熱、刺痛短赤為診斷要點。多因飲食不節（過食辛辣油脂飲酒）或外感濕熱下注引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Lower Burner Excess Heat: Burning urgent dysuria is key diagnostic criteria. Triggered by greasy spicy food, alcohol, or external Damp-Heat invasion.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方八正散（八正散 = 滑石、木通、車前子、萁麥、萁蓄、梔子、大黃、甘草）。核心草藥：滑石、木通、車前子、梔子、燈心草。
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, drain Dampness, unblock urination
records.tongue_en: Red tongue body with yellow greasy coating

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 熱淋以小便頻急灼痛為主,無砂石排出;石淋兼見腰腹絞痛、尿中夾砂石。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heat Lin shows urgent burning urination without gravel; Stone Lin additionally shows colicky flank pain and passage of sand/stones.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 熱淋為實熱證,起病急,苔黃膩、脈滑數;勞淋為虛證,病程久,遇勞即發,脈沉細無力。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heat Lin is an acute excess-heat pattern; Fatigue Lin is a chronic deficiency pattern triggered by exertion, with a deep, thready, weak pulse.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.mechanism_zh: 濕熱蘊結下焦，膀胱氣化不利，故小便頻急、灼熱刺痛而色黃赤短少。
records.mechanism_en: Damp-Heat accumulating in the Lower Burner obstructs Bladder Qi transformation, causing frequent urgent urination with burning pain and dark, scanty urine.
records.common_causes_zh: 過食辛辣油膩或飲酒；外感濕熱下注。
records.common_causes_en: Excessive spicy or greasy food or alcohol; externally contracted Damp-Heat pouring downward.

records.short_summary_zh: 濕熱久蘊下焦，煎熬尿液，凝結成砂石。以腰腹絞痛、尿中夾砂石或血尿、尿道刺痛為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Damp-Heat long accumulating in the Lower Burner, condensing urine into sand or stones. Characterized by severe colicky flank/abdominal pain, sand in urine, or hematuria.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 實證砂石病機：腰腹陣發性絞痛、痛引少腹、排出砂石為三大診斷要點。當加「軟堅散結排石」藥。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Excess Stone Pathomechanism: Paroxysmal colicky flank pain radiating to groin and presence of gravel. Requires herbs that soften hardness and dissolve stones.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Maciocia & Bastyr 考點：必加軟堅排石核心藥對「金錢草、海金沙、雞內金」。代表方三金湯、石韋散。
records.treatment_principle_zh: 清熱利濕，通淋排石，止痛
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, drain Damp, promote urination, expel stones, relieve pain
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with thick yellow greasy coating
records.mechanism_zh: 濕熱久蘊下焦，煎熬尿液而凝結為砂石，阻滯尿路則見腰腹絞痛、尿道刺痛或血尿。
records.mechanism_en: Prolonged Damp-Heat in the Lower Burner concentrates urine into sand or stones; obstruction of the urinary passage produces colicky flank-abdominal pain, urethral pain, or hematuria.
supporting_signs_en: Pain radiating to the lower abdomen or genitals
Passage of sand or stones in urine

records.name_en: Qi Lin - Excess Type (Liver Qi Stagnation)
records.short_summary_zh: 肝氣鬱結，氣機阻滯，膀胱氣化失暢。以小便澀滯、滴瀝不暢、臍下急痛、脅肋脹滿、隨情志變化加重為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Liver Qi stagnation obstructing Qi movement and Bladder transformation. Characterized by hesitant dribbling urination, hypogastric distress, flank distension, and aggravation by emotional stress.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 氣滯實證：排尿困難隨情緒焦慮或生氣加重，無明顯尿道灼熱，伴脅脹腹滿。治當疏肝理氣。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Qi Stagnation Excess: Dysuria worsens with stress/anger, without severe burning heat. Accompanied by flank distension.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Maciocia & Bastyr 考點：代表方沉香散 (Chen Xiang San)。疏肝理氣、利尿通淋。
records.treatment_principle_en: Soothe the Liver, regulate Qi, unblock urination
records.tongue_en: Thin white tongue coating

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 氣淋(實證)以小便澀滯滴瀝、隨情志加重為特徵,無明顯灼熱感;熱淋以小便灼熱刺痛為核心,屬濕熱。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Qi Lin (Excess) is distinguished by hesitant dribbling urination worsened by emotional stress, without burning heat; Heat Lin centers on burning, stabbing urination from Damp-Heat.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.mechanism_zh: 肝氣鬱結，氣機阻滯而使膀胱氣化不暢，故排尿澀滯、滴瀝不暢並隨情志波動加重。
records.mechanism_en: Constrained Liver Qi obstructs Qi movement and Bladder transformation, causing hesitant dribbling urination that worsens with emotional stress.
records.common_causes_zh: 情志不遂或壓力使肝氣鬱結。
records.common_causes_en: Emotional constraint or stress leading to Liver Qi stagnation.
supporting_signs_en: Urinary difficulty aggravated by emotional stress

aliases_en: Dysuria with Hematuria from Blood Heat
records.short_summary_zh: 實熱下注，灼傷血絡，迫血妄行。以小便頻急刺痛、尿色鮮紅或夾有血塊、心煩口渴為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Excess Heat pouring downward into Bladder, injuring Blood collaterals and forcing Blood to spill. Characterized by sharp pain, bright red urine or blood clots, and thirst.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 血分實熱證：尿血鮮紅、割痛難忍。與虛證血淋（尿色淡紅、微痛或無痛、體倦）相對照。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Blood Level Excess Heat: Bright red urine with severe cutting pain. Contrasts with Deficiency Blood Lin (pale red urine, mild ache, fatigue).
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方小薊飲子 (Xiao Ji Yin Zi)。涼血止痛、清熱通淋。
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, cool Blood, stop bleeding, unblock urination
records.tongue_en: Red tongue body with yellow coating

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 血淋(實熱證)兼見尿色鮮紅或夾血塊;熱淋以灼熱刺痛為主,無明顯血尿。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Blood Lin (Excess Heat) additionally shows bright red urine or clots; Heat Lin centers on burning pain without prominent hematuria.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.mechanism_zh: 實熱下注膀胱，灼傷血絡並迫血妄行，故見小便熱痛、尿血鮮紅或夾血塊。
records.mechanism_en: Excess Heat pouring into the Bladder injures the Blood collaterals and forces Blood out of its pathways, causing painful hot urination with bright-red blood or clots.

records.short_summary_zh: 濕熱阻滯下焦，清濁不分，脂液下薛。以小便混濁如米泔水或如脂膏、尿道熱澀刺痛為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Damp-Heat obstructing Lower Burner, failing to separate clear from turbid, allowing fat/essence to spill into urine. Characterized by milky, turbid, or greasy urine with urethral discomfort.
key_manifestations_en: Greasy Fatty Substance Floating in Urine
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 清濁不分病機：尿液渾濁呈米泔或脂膏狀。實證多由濕熱下注，虛證多由脾腎不固。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Turbidity Separation Pathomechanism: Milky or greasy urine appearance. Excess is caused by Damp-Heat; Deficiency is caused by Spleen/Kidney unsteadiness.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & Maciocia 考點：代表方萆薢分清飲 (Bi Xie Fen Qing Yin)。分清別濁、萆薢清熱利濕。
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, drain Dampness, separate clear from turbid
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with white or yellow greasy coating
records.mechanism_zh: 濕熱阻滯下焦，清濁不分，脂液隨小便下泄，故尿液混濁如米泔或浮油如脂膏。
records.mechanism_en: Damp-Heat obstructs the Lower Burner so clear and turbid fluids are not separated and fatty essence spills into the urine, making it milky or greasy.

records.short_summary_zh: 久病淋濁，脾腎虧虛，正氣耗傷。以小便淋漓不已、時作時止、遇勞即發、腰膝痠軟、神疲乏力為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Chronic Lin depleting Spleen and Kidney Qi/Yin. Characterized by recurrent dribbling dysuria triggered by physical or mental exertion, accompanied by fatigue and weak lumbar/knees.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 脾腎本虛病機：病程長，平時隱痛或微感不適，一有勞累或性生活即急性發作。治當補益脾腎。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Spleen & Kidney Root Deficiency: Chronic course, low-grade discomfort flared up by fatigue or overwork. Tx: Tonify Spleen & Kidney.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & Maciocia 考點：代表方無比山藥丸 (Wu Bi Shan Yao Wan) 或補中益氣湯加減。益氣滋陰、固澀小便。
records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify Spleen Qi, strengthen Kidney, consolidate urination
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with thin white coating
records.mechanism_zh: 淋證日久耗傷脾腎，正氣虧虛，固攝與氣化無力，故小便淋漓反覆並在勞累後加重。
records.mechanism_en: Chronic Lin depletes Spleen and Kidney Qi so securing and transforming functions weaken, causing recurrent dribbling urination that worsens after exertion.
records.common_causes_zh: 淋證久延；勞倦耗傷脾腎。
records.common_causes_en: A prolonged course of Lin; overexertion depleting the Spleen and Kidney.
supporting_signs_en: Bearing-down dull pain in the lower abdomen

records.short_summary_zh: 肝鬱化火，火性炎上，上擾清空。以頭痛脹裂、面紅目赤、口苦口乾、急躁易怒、項背緊繃、甚或鼻衄為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Liver Qi stagnation transforming into Fire, surging upward to agitate head and eyes. Characterized by flushed face, splitting headache, tight neck/trapezius, bitter taste, and epistaxis.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 肝經純實熱證：以頭痛脹裂、面紅目赤、口苦咽乾為診斷要點。與肝陽上亢區分——本證為純實無虛，無下焦腰膝痠軟。治當清肝瀉火。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Pure Excess Heat of Liver: Characterized by splitting headache, flushed face, bitter taste without lower body Yin deficiency. Tx: Drain Liver Fire.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Therapeutics 5 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方龍膽瀉肝湯 (Long Dan Xie Gan Tang)。主穴：LR2 行間、LI4 合谷、LI11 曲池、GB20 風池、GV20 百會、ST44 內庭。
records.treatment_principle_en: Calm the Liver, drain Fire, clear head and eyes
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with yellow coating, red edges/tip
records.deprecated_note_zh: 2026-08-08 停用：與 pattern.liver_fire 同為「肝火上炎」的重複匯入記錄（源自高血壓/頭痛專題批次），經 Ting/ChatGPT 正典審查判定為術語變體而非獨立證型。內容已合併進 pattern.liver_fire。未硬刪，id 保留於檔案內供追溯（D6）。對應：DECISIONS.md D16。

records.short_summary_zh: 肝陽化風，風氣上擾，氣血逆亂。以眩暈劇烈、頭痛、肢體麻木震顫、高調耳鳴、舌強語澀、甚或卒倒昏迷為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Hyperactive Liver Yang transforming into Wind, agitating upward and causing Qi/Blood chaos. Characterized by severe vertigo, limb numbness/tremors, tongue stiffness, or stroke/coma.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 中風前兆急症病機：出現肢麻、震顫、言語蹇澀為肝風內動核心。須警惕中風 (Stroke) 發生！中醫診斷多歸屬於眩暈、頭痛或中風範疇。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Stroke Precursor Warning: Numbness, tremors, or dysarthria indicates internal Wind. High alert for imminent stroke!
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Therapeutics 5 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方鎮肝熄風湯 (Zhen Gan Xi Feng Tang)。主穴：GB20 風池、GV20 百會、LR14 期門、LR3 太衝、GB34 陽陵泉、PC7 大陵。
records.treatment_principle_en: Calm Liver Wind, subdue Yang, nourish Yin
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with thin yellow coating
records.deprecated_note_zh: 2026-08-08 停用：與 pattern.liver_wind 同為「肝風內動」的重複匯入記錄（源自高血壓/中風前兆專題批次），經 Ting/ChatGPT 正典審查判定生物醫學情境（中風/TIA vs 帕金森氏症）不構成獨立證型。內容已合併進 pattern.liver_wind。未硬刪，id 保留於檔案內供追溯（D6）。對應：DECISIONS.md D16。

records.short_summary_zh: 腎水不足，不能上濟心火；心火偏亢，不能下溫腎水。以心煩不寐、入睡困難、心悸健忘、頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、五心煩熱為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Kidney Water failing to rise to nourish Heart, while Heart Fire flares unrestrained. Characterized by severe insomnia, difficulty falling asleep, palpitations, tinnitus, lumbar soreness, and five-center heat.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 心腎失調病機：心火上炎（心煩失眠、舌尖紅）與腎陰下虛（腰膝痠軟、耳鳴）並見。治療強調「交通心腎、水火相濟」。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Disharmony of Water and Fire: Heart Fire flaring (insomnia, red tip) coexisting with Kidney Yin deficiency (sore knees, tinnitus). Tx: Connect Heart and Kidney.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Insomnia Therapeutics & NCCAOM 考點：代表方黃連阿膠湯 (Huang Lian A Jiao Tang) 或交泰丸。主穴：HT7 神門、KI3 太溪、SP6 三陰交、Anmian 安眠。
records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish Yin, clear Fire, harmonize Heart and Kidney
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with red tip and scanty coating
records.deprecated_note_zh: 2026-08-08 停用：與 pattern.heart_kidney_not_communicating 同為「心腎不交」的重複匯入記錄，經 Ting/ChatGPT 正典審查判定為重複。內容已合併進 pattern.heart_kidney_not_communicating（別名、來源、方劑、穴位、關聯病症）。未硬刪，id 保留於檔案內供追溯（D6）。對應：DECISIONS.md D16。

key_signs_en: Strong thirst, preference for cold drinks
supporting_signs_en: Dark or scant-red urine may occur
records.tongue_en: Red tongue
records.pulse_en: Slippery, rapid, big and forceful pulse
records.mechanism_zh: 胃中實熱壅盛，熱勢進一步化火。胃火循足陽明經上炎，可灼傷齒齦與口腔；火熱迫津外耗，故口渴喜冷、便秘；胃腐熟功能亢進可見消穀善飢。火熱久留可進一步耗傷胃陰與津液。
records.mechanism_en: Excess Heat accumulates in the Stomach and intensifies into Fire. Stomach Fire flares upward along the Yangming channel, affecting the gums and mouth; strong Heat consumes fluids, producing thirst and constipation, while excessive Stomach activity causes rapid hunger. Persistent Fire can further injure Stomach Yin and fluids.
records.common_causes_zh: 嗜食辛辣肥甘厚膩、胃熱日久化火、情志鬱久化火（部分源流）
records.common_causes_en: Excessive spicy, rich, greasy food; prolonged Stomach Heat intensifying into Fire; in some source traditions, prolonged emotional constraint transforming into internal Heat
records.progression_zh: 胃熱日久可進一步化火，形成胃火熾盛（此為傾向而非必然）；胃火久留可耗傷胃陰，轉為胃陰虛；火熱迫血可致齒衄等出血表現。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Stomach Heat may intensify into Stomach Fire (a tendency, not an absolute progression); persistent Fire can injure Stomach Yin, shifting toward Stomach Yin Deficiency; severe Fire forcing Blood can produce bleeding such as gum bleeding.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: AcuTing 刻意保留兩個獨立正典節點：胃火熾盛熱勢更強，消穀善飢、牙齦腫痛出血、便秘、脈洪大有力等表現更劇；胃熱熾盛為較廣泛/較輕的胃熱概念。部分外部來源（如 Me & Qi）將兩者視為同一證型，AcuTing 保留此來源分歧而不強行統一。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: AcuTing deliberately keeps two separate canonical nodes: Stomach Fire Blazing is the more intense Fire-stage manifestation (stronger hunger, gum swelling/bleeding, constipation, a bigger more forceful pulse); Stomach Heat is the broader, less intense concept. Some external sources (e.g. Me & Qi) treat these as one Pattern — that source disagreement is preserved rather than resolved.
differential_patterns.source: Acuting_OS_Pattern_V1_Canonical_Gap_Pack_StomachFire_WindCold_WindHeat_2026-08-08.md (ChatGPT canonical gap pack, source-backed synthesis of Bastyr/NCBAHM/AD course material)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 胃火熾盛屬純實熱，脈滑數有力；胃陰虛屬虛熱，飢不欲食、舌紅少苔或花剝、脈細，虛熱而非實火。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Stomach Fire Blazing is a pure excess-heat pattern with a forceful pulse; Stomach Yin Deficiency is a deficiency-heat pattern — hunger without desire to eat, a red peeled/scant-coated tongue, and a thin pulse (Empty Heat, not full Fire).
differential_patterns.source: Acuting_OS_Pattern_V1_Canonical_Gap_Pack_StomachFire_WindCold_WindHeat_2026-08-08.md (ChatGPT canonical gap pack, source-backed synthesis of Bastyr/NCBAHM/AD course material)

records.treatment_principle_zh: 清胃瀉火，清熱和胃；火傷津陰者兼養陰生津。
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Stomach Heat, drain Fire and harmonize the Stomach; when Fire has damaged Yin/fluids, also nourish Yin and generate fluids.

key_signs_en: Headache, body aches, or stiff neck/upper back
Nasal congestion with clear, watery discharge
supporting_signs_en: Little thirst, or preference for warm drinks
records.tongue_zh: 舌質正常或淡紅，苔薄白而潤
records.tongue_en: Normal or pale-pink tongue with a thin, white, moist coating
records.pulse_zh: 脈浮緊；表虛(桂枝湯證型)則浮緩
records.pulse_en: Floating, tight pulse in the classic exterior-excess presentation; floating and relaxed/moderate in the exterior-deficiency (Gui Zhi Tang) subtype
records.mechanism_zh: 外感風寒侵襲肌表，風邪開泄而寒邪收引，寒束肌表使衛氣宣發受阻、腠理閉塞，故惡寒較重、無汗、頭身疼痛；肺失宣降則可見鼻塞、清涕、噴嚏與咳嗽。
records.mechanism_en: External Wind-Cold attacks the body surface. Cold constrains the exterior, impairs the circulation of Wei Qi, and closes the pores — producing pronounced chills, absence of sweating, headache, and body aches. When Lung dispersing/descending is affected, nasal congestion, clear discharge, sneezing, and cough may occur.
records.common_causes_zh: 感受風寒之邪、汗出當風、氣候驟變、衛外不固（易感性因素，非唯一病因）
records.common_causes_en: Exposure to Wind and Cold, becoming chilled after sweating, sudden environmental temperature change; insufficient Wei Qi relative to the pathogen increases susceptibility but is not itself the exterior cause
records.progression_zh: 風寒鬱久可化熱轉為風熱或內熱；風寒可進一步影響肺系，成為風寒犯肺之肺系專證；兼夾濕邪則成風寒濕。此三者為傾向，非絕對病程。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Wind-Cold may transform into Wind-Heat or interior Heat; it may further affect the Lung specifically as Wind-Cold Attacking the Lung; combined with Dampness it becomes Wind-Cold-Damp. These are tendencies, not absolute trajectories.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風寒惡寒重於發熱、無汗、鼻涕清稀、咽癢不紅、口不渴、苔薄白、脈浮緊；風熱發熱重於惡寒、可微汗、咽紅腫痛、口渴、鼻涕黃稠、苔薄黃、脈浮數。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Cold shows chills predominating over fever, no sweating, clear watery discharge, an itchy (not red) throat, little thirst, a thin white coating, and a floating tight pulse; Wind-Heat shows fever predominating over chills, possible slight sweating, a red sore throat, thirst, yellow thick discharge, a thin yellow coating, and a floating rapid pulse.
differential_patterns.source: Acuting_OS_Pattern_V1_Canonical_Gap_Pack_StomachFire_WindCold_WindHeat_2026-08-08.md (ChatGPT canonical gap pack, source-backed synthesis of Bastyr/NCBAHM/AD course material)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 本節點（風寒）強調衛表之爭的廣泛外感表現；風寒犯肺為其肺系專證亞型，以咳嗽、痰白清稀、鼻塞等肺氣失宣表現為臨床主軸。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: This general node (Wind-Cold) emphasizes the broad exterior/Wei-level battle; Wind-Cold Attacking the Lung is its Lung-specific subtype, dominated clinically by cough, thin white sputum, and nasal symptoms from impaired Lung Qi.
differential_patterns.source: Acuting_OS_Pattern_V1_Canonical_Gap_Pack_StomachFire_WindCold_WindHeat_2026-08-08.md (ChatGPT canonical gap pack, source-backed synthesis of Bastyr/NCBAHM/AD course material)

records.treatment_principle_zh: 辛溫解表，祛風散寒，宣肺；表虛自汗者兼調和營衛。
records.treatment_principle_en: Release the exterior with acrid-warm methods, dispel Wind-Cold, and restore Lung dispersing/descending; when exterior-deficiency spontaneous sweating predominates, also harmonize Ying and Wei.

key_signs_zh: 發熱重，惡寒較輕或微惡風
key_signs_en: Fever more prominent than chills; mild aversion to wind
Slight sweating, often without full relief of fever
supporting_signs_en: Nasal congestion with yellow, thicker discharge
Cough, sometimes with yellow or sticky sputum
records.tongue_zh: 舌尖紅或舌邊略紅，苔薄，初起可白轉薄黃
records.tongue_en: Red tip or slightly red edges, thin coating — white-to-slightly-yellow very early, thin yellow as Heat becomes clearer
records.pulse_zh: 脈浮數，邪熱較盛時可稍有力
records.pulse_en: Floating, rapid pulse; may be slightly forceful when the pathogen/Heat is stronger
records.mechanism_zh: 風熱之邪侵襲肌表，衛氣與邪相爭而發熱，熱邪開泄腠理可見微汗；風熱上犯肺衛與咽喉，肺失宣降則咳嗽、鼻塞，熱灼津液則口渴、咽紅咽痛。
records.mechanism_en: External Wind-Heat invades the surface and disrupts Wei Qi; the struggle between Wei Qi and the pathogen produces fever, and Heat's opening effect on the pores can cause mild sweating. When Wind-Heat affects the Lung surface and throat, cough and nasal congestion develop, while Heat consuming fluids produces thirst and a red, sore throat.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感風熱之邪、感受季節溫熱病邪、風寒鬱久化熱、誤用溫燥發汗加重熱象
records.common_causes_en: External Wind-Heat invasion, seasonal Warm/Heat pathogen exposure, Wind-Cold transforming into Heat over time, or aggravation of a Heat presentation by incorrect warming treatment
records.progression_zh: 風熱可進一步影響肺系,成為風熱犯肺之肺系專證；熱邪深入可轉為肺熱(裡熱)重證；在溫病體系中,風熱屬衛分階段,可進一步傳入氣分。此為傾向而非必然病程。
records.progression_en: Wind-Heat may further affect the Lung specifically as Wind-Heat Attacking the Lung; deeper penetration of the heat can progress to Lung Heat (an interior pattern); within the Wen-Bing framework, Wind-Heat corresponds to the Wei level and may transmit further to the Qi level. These are tendencies, not an inevitable course.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風熱發熱重於惡寒、可微汗、咽紅腫痛、口渴、鼻涕黃稠、苔薄黃、脈浮數；風寒惡寒重於發熱、無汗、鼻涕清稀、咽癢不紅、口不渴、苔薄白、脈浮緊。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Heat shows fever predominating over chills, possible slight sweating, a red sore throat, thirst, yellow thick discharge, a thin yellow coating, and a floating rapid pulse; Wind-Cold shows chills predominating, no sweating, clear watery discharge, an itchy throat, little thirst, a thin white coating, and a floating tight pulse.
differential_patterns.source: Acuting_OS_Pattern_V1_Canonical_Gap_Pack_StomachFire_WindCold_WindHeat_2026-08-08.md (ChatGPT canonical gap pack, source-backed synthesis of Bastyr/NCBAHM/AD course material)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 本節點（風熱）強調衛分/體表層次的廣泛外感表現；風熱犯肺為其肺系專證亞型，以咳嗽為主症、痰黃更明顯、肺系症狀更突出。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: This general node (Wind-Heat) emphasizes the broad Wei-level/exterior presentation; Wind-Heat Attacking the Lung is its Lung-specific subtype, dominated by cough as the primary symptom with more prominent yellow phlegm and Lung involvement.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風熱為表證，病位淺，脈浮；痰熱壅肺為裡熱重證，痰黃稠量多、胸痛喘促，脈不再主浮，程度較重。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Heat is an exterior pattern with a floating pulse; Phlegm-Heat Obstructing the Lung is a more severe interior-heat pattern with copious thick yellow sputum, chest pain, and dyspnea, and the pulse is no longer chiefly floating.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Qi Deficiency centers on palpitations, breathlessness, sweating, and exertional worsening; Gallbladder Qi Deficiency centers on timidity, startling, and impaired decisiveness.

records.name_en: Kidney Yang Deficiency with Water Flooding
records.mechanism_zh: 腎陽虛衰，氣化水液無力，水濕停聚泛溢，故見水腫與小便不利；水氣上凌時可影響肺或心。
records.mechanism_en: Deficient Kidney Yang fails to transform fluids, allowing Water to accumulate and overflow as edema and impaired urination; upward flooding may affect the Lung or Heart.
key_signs_zh: 小便短少或水液代謝不利
水氣上泛時可見氣短或心悸

Aversion to cold and cold limbs
Sore weak low back and knees
Dyspnea or palpitations may occur when Water floods upward
records.treatment_principle_en: Warm and tonify Kidney Yang, transform Qi, and move retained Water

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 一般腎陽虛可有寒象與尿頻；水泛型以明顯水腫、小便不利及水氣上凌為辨識核心。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: General Kidney Yang Deficiency has Cold and urinary signs; the Water-Flooding subtype is defined by marked edema, impaired urination, and possible upward flooding.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 脾腎陽虛兼見納差、腹脹、便溏等脾陽不振；腎陽虛水泛以腎系寒象與水腫泛溢為主。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency adds poor appetite, abdominal distension, and loose stool; Kidney Yang Deficiency with Water Flooding centers on Kidney Cold and overflowing edema.
differential_patterns.source: Acuting_OS_TCM_Pattern_Expansion_Research_Pack_v0.3_Batch03_ZangFu_2026-08-08.md §KI08; Acuting_OS_Pattern_V2_Final_Canonical_Decision_Pack_2026-08-08.md

differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Lower-Burner Damp-Heat is a broader lower-burner mechanism; Bladder Damp-Heat is specifically localized to Bladder transformation and urinary signs.

records.mechanism_zh: 肝腎陰液同源而互相滋養；兩者俱虛時，目、筋、腰膝與耳竅失養，並可出現虛熱。
records.mechanism_en: Liver and Kidney Yin share a common source and mutually nourish each other; combined deficiency deprives the eyes, sinews, low back, knees, and ears of nourishment and may produce deficiency Heat.
key_signs_en: Sore weak low back and knees
records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish Liver and Kidney Yin

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝腎陰虛除眼乾、筋脈失養外，兼見腰膝痠軟、耳鳴等腎陰虛表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver-Kidney Yin Deficiency adds sore low back and knees and tinnitus to the eye and sinew signs of Liver Yin Deficiency.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM patterns/ad_batches/03_AD_PATTERN_LIVER_GALLBLADDER.md §肝腎陰虛

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝腎陰虛除腰膝痠軟與耳鳴外，兼見眼乾、視物模糊等肝陰不足表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver-Kidney Yin Deficiency adds dry or blurred eyes and other Liver Yin signs to the low-back and tinnitus signs of Kidney Yin Deficiency.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM patterns/ad_batches/03_AD_PATTERN_LIVER_GALLBLADDER.md §肝腎陰虛

records.mechanism_zh: 肝火上逆犯肺，肺失清肅下降，故咳嗽劇烈並隨情志或怒氣加重。
records.mechanism_en: Liver Fire rebels upward and scorches the Lung, impairing Lung clearing and descending and causing forceful cough worsened by anger or emotional upset.
key_signs_zh: 陣發性劇烈乾咳，怒則加重
痰少黏難咯或痰中帶血
key_signs_en: Severe paroxysmal dry cough worsened by anger
Scant sticky difficult sputum or blood-streaked sputum
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Liver Fire, clear the Lung, and restore descending

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝火犯肺除肝火上炎表現外，以咳嗽、痰少或痰血等肺失肅降為核心。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Fire Scorching Lung adds cough, scant sputum, or blood-streaked sputum from impaired Lung descending to the Liver Fire picture.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM patterns/ad_batches/03_AD_PATTERN_LIVER_GALLBLADDER.md §肝火犯肺

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰熱壅肺以痰黃稠量多、胸悶為主；肝火犯肺多為情志誘發的乾咳或少痰，兼口苦脅痛。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm-Heat in the Lung centers on copious thick yellow sputum and chest oppression; Liver Fire Scorching Lung is often emotion-triggered, dry or scant-phlegm cough with bitter taste and hypochondriac pain.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM patterns/ad_batches/03_AD_PATTERN_LIVER_GALLBLADDER.md §肝火犯肺; Acuting_OS_Pattern_V2_Final_Canonical_Decision_Pack_2026-08-08.md

records.tongue_zh: 舌邊尖紅或紅乾，苔薄黃或厚黃
records.tongue_en: Red edges and tip or a red dry tongue, with a thin or thick yellow coating
records.pulse_en: Wiry rapid or slippery rapid pulse

records.mechanism_zh: 心陰與腎陰同虧，心神失養而腎水不足，虛熱內擾，故失眠心悸與腰膝、耳竅等腎陰虛表現並見。
records.mechanism_en: Combined Heart and Kidney Yin deficiency deprives the Shen of nourishment and leaves Kidney Water insufficient, allowing deficiency Heat to disturb the Heart while Kidney Yin signs coexist.
key_signs_en: Sore weak low back and knees
records.treatment_principle_zh: 滋養心腎之陰，清虛熱，安神
records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish Heart and Kidney Yin, clear deficiency Heat, and calm the Shen

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心腎陰虛明確要求心陰、腎陰兩組不足與虛熱並見；心腎不交是較廣的功能失和概念，不能視為 exact identity。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart-Kidney Yin Deficiency requires combined Heart and Kidney Yin deficiency with deficiency Heat; Heart-Kidney Not Communicating is a broader functional disharmony and is not an exact identity.
differential_patterns.source: Acuting_OS_Pattern_V2_Final_Canonical_Decision_Pack_2026-08-08.md

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心腎陰虛除腎陰虛的腰膝痠軟、耳鳴與虛熱外，另有心悸、失眠多夢等心陰失養表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart-Kidney Yin Deficiency adds palpitations and dream-disturbed insomnia from Heart Yin deficiency to the Kidney Yin deficiency picture.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM patterns/ad_batches/01_AD_PATTERN_HEART_SHEN.md §心腎陰虛; https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/heart-and-kidney-yin-deficiency

records.tongue_en: Red tongue with little or no coating

records.mechanism_zh: 寒與痰相結壅阻於肺，肺氣宣降失常，故咳嗽、痰白清稀或泡沫量多，並見寒象。
records.mechanism_en: Cold combines with Phlegm and obstructs the Lung, impairing Lung diffusion and descent and producing cough with copious white, clear, thin, or frothy sputum together with Cold signs.
key_signs_zh: 痰色白而清稀或呈泡沫
key_signs_en: White, clear, thin, or frothy sputum
Aversion to cold and cold limbs
Absence of thirst or preference for warm drinks
records.treatment_principle_en: Warm the Lung, disperse Cold, transform Phlegm, and restore descending

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰濕阻肺以痰多黏濁、胸悶困重為主；寒痰阻肺的痰更清稀白滑，並有明顯畏寒、肢冷與喜溫。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm-Damp in the Lung centers on copious sticky sputum, oppression, and heaviness; Cold-Phlegm has clearer, thinner white sputum with marked cold limbs, aversion to cold, and preference for warmth.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM Pathology 1 & 2 notes.md

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰熱壅肺見黃稠痰、口渴、舌紅苔黃膩、脈滑數；寒痰阻肺則見白清稀痰、寒象、舌淡苔白滑、脈滑遲。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm-Heat in the Lung has thick yellow sputum, thirst, a red tongue with yellow greasy coating, and a slippery rapid pulse; Cold-Phlegm has clear white thin sputum, Cold signs, a pale tongue with white slippery coating, and a slippery slow pulse.
differential_patterns.source: https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/phlegm-heat

records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with a white slippery or greasy coating

records.mechanism_zh: 痰濁與內風相搏，風動而痰隨之上擾或窜絡，使清竅、經絡或竅竅受阻，故以眩暈、震顫、麻木、口眼偏斜或突發運動異常為特徵。
records.mechanism_en: Phlegm combines with internal Wind; Wind movement carries Phlegm upward or into the channels and orifices, producing dizziness, tremor, numbness, facial deviation, or other sudden movement-related manifestations.
key_signs_zh: 症狀突發、變動或具動風特徵
key_signs_en: Dizziness or a heavy clouded head
records.treatment_principle_en: Transform Phlegm, extinguish Wind, open the channels, and clear the orifices as appropriate

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰濕以痰多、胸悶、身重、納差為主；風痰以眩暈、震顫、麻木、偏斜等動風或經絡表現為高價值鑑別點。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm-Damp centers on sputum, chest oppression, heaviness, and poor appetite; Wind-Phlegm is distinguished by dizziness, tremor, numbness, deviation, and other Wind or channel manifestations.
differential_patterns.source: https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/concepts/phlegm-as-a-pathological-product

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝風以動風現象為核心；風痰除動風外，還要有痰濁證據，如頭重昏蒙、麻木、膩苔或滑脈。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Wind is defined by Wind movement; Wind-Phlegm additionally requires evidence of Phlegm such as a clouded heavy head, numbness, a greasy coating, or a slippery pulse.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM Pathology 1 & 2 notes.md; https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/phlegm

records.tongue_en: Greasy or sticky tongue coating

records.mechanism_zh: 盛夏暑熱與濕邪相合，暑熱逼津而濕邪困阻中焦與氣機，故熱象與身重、胸脸痞悶、納呆惡心等濕象並見。
records.mechanism_en: Summerheat combines with Dampness in hot, humid conditions; Heat pressures fluids while Dampness encumbers the middle burner and Qi movement, producing Heat signs together with heaviness, oppression, poor appetite, and nausea.
key_signs_zh: 身體沉重倦怠，頭重如裹
key_signs_en: Fever or Heat constrained by Dampness
Heavy fatigued body and a swathed heavy head
Thirst with little desire to drink
records.treatment_principle_zh: 清解暑熱，芳化或滲利濕邪，和中理氣
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Summerheat, transform or drain Dampness, and harmonize the middle burner

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 脾胃濕熱是定位中焦的臟腑證；暑濕需有暑季或炎熱潮濕暴露的病因背景，並兼暑熱特徵。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Spleen-Stomach Damp-Heat is a Zang-Fu pattern localized to the middle burner; Summerheat-Dampness requires a summer or hot-humid etiologic context with Summerheat features.
differential_patterns.source: https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/summer-heat-with-dampness

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風熱以發熱、微惡風、咽痛、脈浮數為主；暑濕的身重、頭重、胸脸痞悶、納呆與濡脈更突出。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Heat centers on fever, mild aversion to wind, sore throat, and a floating rapid pulse; Summerheat-Dampness is marked by heaviness, a swathed head, chest-epigastric oppression, poor appetite, and a soggy pulse.
differential_patterns.source: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/206952/9789290612487_eng.pdf

records.tongue_zh: 舌紅，苔黃膩或白黃相兼而膩
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with a yellow greasy or mixed white-yellow greasy coating

records.mechanism_zh: 初秋餘熱與燥邪相合外襲肺衛，燥傷肺津並使肺失宣降，故乾咳、痰少難咯、鼻咽乾燥，並見較明顯溫熱象。
records.mechanism_en: In early autumn, residual warmth combines with Dryness and attacks the Lung and defensive level; Dryness damages Lung fluids and impairs diffusion and descent, causing dry cough and dry airways with Warm-Heat signs.
key_signs_en: Dry cough or scant sticky difficult sputum
Dry nose and dry or sore throat
Thirst with preference for cold drinks
More prominent fever with milder chills
records.treatment_principle_zh: 辛涼透表，清宣肺熱，潤燥生津
records.treatment_principle_en: Gently release the exterior with cool acrid methods, clear and diffuse Lung Heat, and moisten Dryness to generate fluids

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 溫燥以發熱、口渴、咽痛、舌尖紅、苔薄黃乾與脈浮數為主；涼燥則惡寒較著、不渴或渴少，苔白乾、脈浮緊。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Warm-Dryness has more fever, thirst, sore throat, a red tip with a thin yellow dry coat, and a floating rapid pulse; Cool-Dryness has stronger chills, little thirst, a white dry coat, and a floating tight pulse.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM Pathology 1 & 2 notes.md; https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/dry-cold

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風熱犯肺可見咽痛與咳嗽，但溫燥犯肺以鼻咽乾燥、乾咳或痰少黏難咯與乾苔為核心。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Heat may also cause sore throat and cough, but Warm-Dryness is defined by dry nose and throat, dry cough or scant sticky sputum, and a dry tongue coating.
differential_patterns.source: https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/concepts/dryness-as-a-pathogen

records.tongue_en: Red tongue tip with a thin yellow dry coating

records.mechanism_zh: 深秋涼邪與燥邪相合外襲肺衛，涼邪束表，燥邪傷津，肺失宣降，故惡寒無汗與鼻咽乾、乾咳痰少並見。
records.mechanism_en: In late autumn, Coolness combines with Dryness and attacks the Lung and defensive level; Coolness constrains the exterior while Dryness damages fluids and impairs Lung diffusion and descent.
key_signs_en: Dry cough with scant or sticky difficult sputum
No thirst or only slight thirst
records.treatment_principle_en: Gently warm and release the exterior, diffuse the Lung, and moisten Dryness

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 涼燥以惡寒、無汗、不渴或渴少、苔白乾、脈浮緊為主；溫燥則發熱與口渴較著，舌尖紅、苔薄黃乾、脈浮數。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Cool-Dryness has stronger chills, no sweating, little thirst, a white dry coat, and a floating tight pulse; Warm-Dryness has more fever and thirst, a red tip with thin yellow dry coat, and a floating rapid pulse.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM Pathology 1 & 2 notes.md; https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/dry-cold

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風寒犯肺常見清稀鼻涕與白稀痰，苔薄白而潤；涼燥犯肺以鼻咽乾、乾咳痰少與乾苔為鑑別重點。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Cold commonly has copious clear nasal discharge, thin white sputum, and a moist white coat; Cool-Dryness is distinguished by dry nose and throat, dry cough with scant sputum, and a dry coating.
differential_patterns.source: https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/dry-cold

records.tongue_zh: 舌淡或淡紅，苔薄白而乾
records.tongue_en: Pale or pale-red tongue with a thin white dry coating

records.mechanism_zh: 病程中寒與熱的真實病理狀態同時存在，可分居上下、表裏或不同臟腑部位，因而出現相互矛盾的寒熱表現。
records.mechanism_en: Genuine Cold and genuine Heat coexist in the same disease process, potentially in different upper-lower, exterior-interior, or organ locations, producing clinically contradictory Cold and Heat manifestations.
key_signs_zh: 可見上熱下寒或上寒下熱
可見表寒裏熱或表熱裏寒
寒熱表現分屬不同部位或病理層次
key_signs_en: Simultaneous genuine Cold and Heat manifestations
Possible upper Heat with lower Cold or upper Cold with lower Heat
Possible exterior Cold with interior Heat or exterior Heat with interior Cold
Cold and Heat findings belong to different locations or pathologic layers

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 寒熱錯雜是一般八綱複合 identity；表寒裏熱明確要求寒在表、熱在裏的特定空間分佈。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Mixed Cold and Heat is the general Eight-Principle compound identity; Exterior Cold with Interior Heat requires the specific distribution of Cold at the exterior and Heat in the interior.
differential_patterns.source: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/206952/9789290612487_eng.pdf

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 寒熱錯雜中寒、熱皆為真實病理狀態；真寒假熱只有寒為本質，熱象是假象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: In Mixed Cold and Heat, both Cold and Heat are genuine; in True Cold with False Heat, Cold is the true nature and the Heat appearance is deceptive.
differential_patterns.source: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/352306/9789240042322-eng.pdf?sequence=1

differentiation: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/206952/9789290612487_eng.pdf
https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/352306/9789240042322-eng.pdf?sequence=1

records.mechanism_zh: 風寒束表，腠理閉鬱，而裏熱已存或郁而化熱；外寒遏制與內熱壅滯同時存在。
records.mechanism_en: Wind-Cold constrains the exterior and closes the pores while Interior Heat is already present or develops from constraint, so external Cold signs coexist with genuine internal Heat signs.
key_signs_zh: 可見咽痛、黃痰、便結或尿黃
key_signs_en: Concurrent aversion to cold and fever
Absence of sweating with headache and body aches
Thirst with preference for cold drinks
Possible sore throat, yellow sputum, constipation, or dark urine
records.treatment_principle_en: Release Exterior Cold while clearing Interior Heat

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 單純風寒以惡寒、無汗、身痛、清稀分泌物與白潤苔為主，不見煩渴、黃痰、便結或尿黃等裏熱證據。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Simple Wind-Cold has chills, no sweating, body aches, clear discharges, and a white moist coat without the restlessness, thirst, yellow sputum, constipation, or dark urine that establish Interior Heat.
differential_patterns.source: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/206952/9789290612487_eng.pdf

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 表寒裏熱是寒熱錯雜的特定型，病位分佈已鎖定為表寒與裏熱；一般寒熱錯雜不預設此分佈。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Exterior Cold with Interior Heat is a specific Mixed Cold-Heat distribution; generic Mixed Cold and Heat does not prespecify where the two qualities are located.
differential_patterns.source: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/206952/9789290612487_eng.pdf

records.tongue_zh: 舌紅，苔薄白或黃白相兼
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with a thin white or mixed white-yellow coating
records.pulse_en: Floating tight pulse, possibly also rapid

records.mechanism_zh: 裏寒極盛或陽氣衰微，使陽氣浮越於外，以致真實寒證之上出現面紅、發熱感、煩躁或口渴等假熱表現。
records.mechanism_en: Severe Interior Cold or failing Yang forces Yang outward, so deceptive Heat appearances such as flushed cheeks, subjective fever, agitation, or thirst overlay genuine Cold signs.
key_signs_zh: 手足厥冷或胸腹觸之冷
面頠浮紅或自覺發熱但喜覆衣被
key_signs_en: Reversal-cold hands and feet or a chest and abdomen cold to touch
Diarrhea with undigested food or loose stool
Floating malar flush or subjective fever while still desiring covers
Thirst with preference for hot water

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 真寒假熱只有寒為真實病性，熱象是陽氣浮越的假象；寒熱錯雜則是真寒與真熱同時存在。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: True Cold with False Heat has genuine Cold with deceptive Heat appearances; Mixed Cold and Heat contains genuine Cold and genuine Heat at the same time.
differential_patterns.source: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/352306/9789240042322-eng.pdf?sequence=1

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎陽虛是定位腎系的虛寒證，不必出現假熱；真寒假熱是八綱對病性真假的判定，其面紅、發熱感或口渴不代表真熱。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Yang Deficiency is organ-specific deficiency-Cold and does not require false Heat; True Cold with False Heat is an Eight-Principle judgment about deceptive Heat appearances over a Cold nature.
differential_patterns.source: curriculum/conditions/TCM patterns/Acuting_OS_Pattern_V2_Final_Canonical_Decision_Pack_2026-08-08.md; https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/352306/9789240042322-eng.pdf?sequence=1

records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with a white coating

records.mechanism_zh: 風、寒、濕邪合而侵襲經絡與關節，氣血運行受阻，故出現疼痛、僵硬、沉重與活動受限；三邪偏盛不同，疼痛可偏遊走、劇烈或固定重著。
records.mechanism_en: Wind, Cold, and Dampness invade the channels and joints and obstruct Qi and Blood movement, causing pain, stiffness, heaviness, and restricted movement; the dominant pathogen shapes whether pain is moving, severe, or fixed and heavy.
key_signs_zh: 疼痛遇寒、潮濕或陰雨加重
key_signs_en: Pain worsened by cold, damp, or rainy weather
Affected areas are usually not red or hot
records.treatment_principle_zh: 祛風散寒，除濕通絡，止痛
records.treatment_principle_en: Dispel Wind, scatter Cold, eliminate Dampness, open the channels, and relieve pain

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風濕痹阻以遊走疼痛、沉重與活動不利為主；風寒濕痹更明確要求寒性疼痛特徵，即遇寒加重、得溫則減。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Damp Bi centers on moving pain, heaviness, and impaired movement; Wind-Cold-Damp Bi explicitly requires Cold-type pain that worsens with cold and improves with warmth.
differential_patterns.source: https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/wind-cold-damp

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 熱痹以關節紅、腫、熱、痛，觸之灼熱，遇熱加重為主；風寒濕痹多不紅不熱，遇寒濕加重、得溫痛減。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heat Bi has red, swollen, hot, painful joints that worsen with heat; Wind-Cold-Damp Bi is usually not red or hot, worsens with cold-damp exposure, and improves with warmth.
differential_patterns.source: https://www.meandqi.com/knowledge-base/patterns/painful-obstruction-with-wind-cold-damp

records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with a white greasy coating

key_signs_en: Shortness of breath, reluctance to speak
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with a white coating
records.mechanism_zh: 元氣不足,臟腑機能活動減退,推動、固攝、氣化功能皆弱。此為上位分類,實際臨床須辨明是哪一臟腑之氣虛(肺氣虛、脾氣虛、心氣虛等,見各下位證型卡),本卡描述的是各型共有的氣虛總象。
records.mechanism_en: Insufficient original qi weakens the propelling, containing, and transforming functions shared by all organs. This is a category-level node: the clinical diagnosis must specify which organ's qi is deficient (Lung/Spleen/Heart Qi Deficiency etc., see the individual pattern cards) -- this card describes the presentation common to all of them.
records.common_causes_zh: 先天稟賦不足、飲食失調化源不足、勞倦過度耗氣、久病傷氣
records.common_causes_en: Congenital insufficiency, poor diet failing to generate qi, overexertion depleting qi, chronic illness consuming qi
records.progression_zh: 氣虛日久,氣損及陽可發展為陽虛;氣不生血可致氣血兩虛;氣虛不攝可致自汗、崩漏、臟器下垂等不固之症。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Qi Deficiency can progress to Yang Deficiency (qi depletion reaching yang); qi failing to generate blood can lead to combined Qi-Blood Deficiency; qi's failure to contain can cause spontaneous sweating, abnormal bleeding, or organ prolapse.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 氣虛以乏力、氣短、自汗為主,無明顯寒象;陽虛在氣虛基礎上兼見畏寒肢冷、小便清長等寒象,是氣虛的進一步發展。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Qi Deficiency centers on fatigue, shortness of breath, and spontaneous sweating without cold signs; Yang Deficiency adds cold signs (aversion to cold, cold limbs, clear copious urine) on top of qi deficiency -- a further stage.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 氣虛舌淡苔白;陽虛舌淡胖
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 氣虛脈虛弱;陽虛脈沉遲無力
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 本卡(氣虛)是不分臟腑的總綱;脾氣虛是氣虛在脾之定位,兼見食少、腹脹、便溏等運化失職的特定表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: This card is the un-localized general category; Spleen Qi Deficiency is qi deficiency located in the Spleen specifically, adding poor appetite, abdominal distension, and loose stools from impaired transformation-transportation.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify qi
records.point_rationale_zh: 氣海、關元培補元氣;足三里健運脾胃、後天化氣之源;脾俞助運化以資氣生。
records.point_rationale_en: CV6 and CV4 nourish original qi; ST36 strengthens Spleen-Stomach transformation, the postnatal source of qi; BL20 supports the Spleen to generate qi.
sources: 中醫基礎理論 教材通用(氣血津液辨證/八綱辨證/病因辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.tongue_en: Pale tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 血液虧虛,臟腑、經脈、官竅失於濡養。為上位分類,臨床常見心血虛、肝血虛等定位證型(見各下位卡),本卡述其共有總象。
records.mechanism_en: Insufficient blood fails to nourish the organs, channels, and sensory orifices. A category-level node -- the common clinical forms are Heart Blood Deficiency, Liver Blood Deficiency etc. (see individual cards); this card describes the shared presentation.
records.common_causes_zh: 失血過多、脾胃虛弱化源不足、久病暗耗營血、思慮過度暗耗心血
records.common_causes_en: Excessive blood loss, Spleen-Stomach weakness failing to generate blood, chronic illness silently consuming nutritive blood, excessive overthinking depleting Heart blood
records.progression_zh: 血虛可致氣虛(血不化氣、血不載氣);血虛生風可見肌膚瘙癢、震顫(血虛風燥);婦女血虛可致月經量少、閉經。
records.progression_en: Blood Deficiency can lead to Qi Deficiency (blood fails to generate/carry qi); Blood Deficiency can generate internal wind, causing itching or tremor (Blood Deficiency with Wind); in women it can cause scanty menstruation or amenorrhea.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 血虛以面色/脣甲淡白、頭暈眼花、心悸為主症;氣虛以乏力氣短、自汗為主症,較少明顯面色/脣甲色淡。氣血常相兼,但主症側重不同。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Blood Deficiency centers on a pale complexion/lips/nails, dizziness, and palpitations; Qi Deficiency centers on fatigue, shortness of breath, and spontaneous sweating with less pallor. The two often coexist but the leading signs differ.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 血虛舌淡而質地可正常;氣虛舌淡兼胖或苔白偏厚
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 血虛無熱象;陰虛有虛熱象(五心煩熱、潮熱盜汗、舌紅少苔),二者皆可見瘦弱、失眠,但陰虛偏熱、血虛偏淡白無熱。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Blood Deficiency shows no heat signs; Yin Deficiency shows deficiency-heat signs (five-center heat, tidal fever, night sweats, red tongue with scant coating). Both can show emaciation and insomnia, but Yin Deficiency runs hot while Blood Deficiency stays pale without heat.
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 血虛脈細;陰虛脈細數
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify blood
records.point_rationale_zh: 三陰交、血海調補肝脾以生血;足三里健脾助化源;膈俞為血會,養血和血。
records.point_rationale_en: SP6 and SP10 regulate Liver-Spleen to generate blood; ST36 strengthens the Spleen as blood's source; BL17, the Hui-Meeting point of blood, nourishes and harmonizes blood.
sources: 中醫基礎理論 教材通用(氣血津液辨證/八綱辨證/病因辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.tongue_en: Red tongue with scant or no coating
records.mechanism_zh: 陰液虧虛,不能制陽,虛熱內生。為八綱層級的上位分類,臨床常定位為腎陰虛、肺陰虛、肝陰虛等(見各下位卡)。
records.mechanism_en: Depleted yin fluids fail to restrain yang, generating deficiency-heat internally. A category-level node at the Eight-Principles tier -- clinically usually localized as Kidney/Lung/Liver Yin Deficiency etc. (see individual cards).
records.common_causes_zh: 久病傷陰、熱病後期傷津、房勞過度、五志化火暗耗陰液
records.common_causes_en: Chronic illness injuring yin, heat disease in its later stage consuming fluids, excessive sexual activity, emotional fire silently consuming yin fluids
records.progression_zh: 陰虛日久陰損及陽,可成陰陽兩虛;陰虛動風可見手足蠕動、震顫(虛風內動)。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Yin Deficiency can deplete yang as well, becoming combined Yin-Yang Deficiency; Yin Deficiency can generate internal wind, causing wriggling movements or tremor of the hands and feet.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 陰虛屬虛熱(五心煩熱、潮熱盜汗、舌紅少苔);陽虛屬虛寒(畏寒肢冷、舌淡胖、脈沉遲),寒熱屬性相反,不會同見於同一分型。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Yin Deficiency is deficiency-heat (five-center heat, tidal fever, red tongue with scant coating); Yang Deficiency is deficiency-cold (aversion to cold, cold limbs, pale swollen tongue, deep slow pulse) -- opposite thermal natures.
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 陰虛脈細數;陽虛脈沉遲無力
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 本卡(陰虛)為不分臟腑的總綱;腎陰虛是陰虛在腎之定位,兼見腰膝酸軟、耳鳴遺精等腎系特定表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: This card is the un-localized general category; Kidney Yin Deficiency is yin deficiency located in the Kidney specifically, adding lower-back/knee weakness, tinnitus, and seminal emission.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish yin
records.point_rationale_zh: 太谿、照海滋補腎陰;三陰交滋養肝脾腎三陰。
records.point_rationale_en: KI3 and KI6 nourish Kidney yin; SP6 nourishes the three Yin channels of Liver, Spleen and Kidney.
sources: 中醫基礎理論 教材通用(氣血津液辨證/八綱辨證/病因辨證章節,課程層級引用)

key_signs_en: Cold, aching lower back and knees
records.tongue_en: Pale, swollen tongue with a white coating
records.mechanism_zh: 陽氣虛衰,溫煦氣化功能減退,陰寒內生。為八綱層級的上位分類,臨床常定位為腎陽虛、脾陽虛、心陽虛等(見各下位卡)。
records.mechanism_en: Weakened yang qi loses its warming and transforming power, generating internal cold. A category-level node at the Eight-Principles tier -- clinically usually localized as Kidney/Spleen/Heart Yang Deficiency etc. (see individual cards).
records.common_causes_zh: 素體陽虛、久病傷陽、寒涼藥物或飲食損傷陽氣、年老命火漸衰
records.common_causes_en: Constitutional yang weakness, chronic illness injuring yang, cold-natured medicine or diet damaging yang qi, gradual decline of Ming-Men fire with age
records.progression_zh: 陽虛進一步衰竭可致亡陽(大汗淋漓、四肢厥冷、脈微欲絕);陽虛不能化氣行水可致水腫、痰飲(陽虛水泛)。
records.progression_en: Severe further decline of Yang Deficiency can lead to Yang Collapse (profuse sweating, cold limbs, faint pulse); Yang's failure to transform and move water can cause edema or phlegm-fluid retention.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 陽虛在氣虛基礎上兼有明顯寒象(畏寒肢冷、小便清長);氣虛無明顯寒象,僅乏力氣短自汗。陽虛可視為氣虛之進一步發展(氣損及陽)。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Yang Deficiency adds clear cold signs (aversion to cold, cold limbs, clear urine) on top of qi deficiency; Qi Deficiency alone shows no such cold signs. Yang Deficiency can be seen as a further stage of Qi Deficiency.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 氣虛舌淡苔白;陽虛舌淡胖
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 陽虛脈沉遲無力,寒象直接可見,無假熱表現;若陽虛進一步發展至陽氣被格拒於外,可見面赤、煩躁等假熱之象而實為真寒假熱,是本證重篤階段的變局,不可誤判為熱證而用寒涼。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Yang Deficiency shows a deep, slow, forceless pulse with directly visible cold signs and no false-heat display; if Yang Deficiency progresses to the point that yang is repelled outward, a false-heat appearance (flushed face, agitation) can emerge while the root remains cold -- a severe-stage variant of this pattern, not to be mistaken for a heat pattern and treated with cooling herbs.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Warm yang
records.point_rationale_zh: 關元、氣海、命門、腎俞溫補腎陽、培補元陽,多配合灸法。
records.point_rationale_en: CV4, CV6, GV4 and BL23 warm and tonify Kidney/original yang, often combined with moxibustion.
sources: 中醫基礎理論 教材通用(氣血津液辨證/八綱辨證/病因辨證章節,課程層級引用)

key_signs_en: Thirst with preference for cold drinks
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with a yellow coating
records.mechanism_zh: 陽熱偏盛或陰不制陽,機能活動亢奮。八綱寒熱一級分類,可為外感實熱(邪熱熾盛)或內傷虛熱(陰虛生熱),須再辨表裡虛實方能定治法。
records.mechanism_en: Excess yang heat, or yin's failure to restrain yang, drives hyperactive bodily function. The primary Cold-Heat axis of the Eight Principles; can be exterior excess heat (an invading pathogen) or interior deficiency heat (yin deficiency generating heat) -- exterior/interior and deficiency/excess must be further differentiated to set treatment.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感熱邪、五志過極化火、過食辛辣助熱、陰虛不能制陽而生內熱
records.common_causes_en: Invasion by a heat pathogen, extreme emotions transforming into fire, excessive spicy/hot food, yin deficiency failing to restrain yang and generating internal heat
records.progression_zh: 熱盛可傷津動血動風(高熱動風、熱迫血妄行);熱極可生寒(真熱假寒,格陽於外)。
records.progression_en: Extreme heat can injure fluids, force blood to move recklessly, or generate wind (high fever causing convulsions, heat forcing bleeding); at its extreme, heat can produce a false-cold appearance (true heat, false cold with yang repelled outward).

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 熱證多瀰漫全身、病勢相對緩和持續;火證是熱之極,病位較局限於某一臟腑並見上炎化毒之象(口舌生瘡、齒齦腫痛、甚則吐衄),病勢更急更重。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heat tends to be diffuse and sustained; Fire is heat at its extreme, more localized to one organ with flaring/toxic signs (mouth ulcers, swollen gums, even bleeding) -- a more acute, severe presentation.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 此卡多指實熱(邪盛);陰虛之熱為虛熱,以午後潮熱、盜汗、舌紅少苔為特徵,無外感表證,病程較久。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: This card usually denotes excess heat (pathogen predominance); Yin Deficiency heat is deficiency-heat, marked by afternoon tidal fever, night sweats, and a red tongue with scant coating, without exterior signs, and a chronic course.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heat
records.point_rationale_zh: 曲池、大椎清瀉熱邪;合谷助解表退熱。
records.point_rationale_en: LI11 and GV14 clear and drain heat; LI4 assists in releasing the exterior and reducing fever.
sources: 中醫基礎理論 教材通用(氣血津液辨證/八綱辨證/病因辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.tongue_zh: 舌紅苔黃,甚則舌尖紅赤起刺
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with a yellow coating, in severe cases red, prickled tongue tip
records.mechanism_zh: 陽熱亢盛已極,火性炎上、易生風動血、易灼傷津液,多局限於某一臟腑並見化毒之象。
records.mechanism_en: Yang heat at its extreme; fire's nature is to flare upward, readily generates wind, forces blood to move, and scorches fluids -- usually localized to a specific organ with toxic-heat signs.
records.common_causes_zh: 五志過極化火(尤怒、思)、外感邪氣入裡化火、臟腑陽熱素盛、過食辛辣厚味助火
records.common_causes_en: Extreme emotions transforming into fire (especially anger, overthinking), an exterior pathogen entering the interior and transforming into fire, constitutional organ-heat, excessive spicy/rich food fueling fire
records.progression_zh: 火盛動風可見高熱抽搐;火迫血妄行可見吐血衄血;火毒熾盛可成癰瘍。
records.progression_en: Extreme fire can generate wind, causing high fever and convulsions; fire forcing blood recklessly can cause vomiting/nosebleeds; extreme fire-toxin can become an abscess.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 火證病位較局限(某一臟腑)且病勢更急更重,常見上炎化毒之象;熱證病位較瀰漫、程度相對輕緩。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Fire is more localized (one organ) and more acute/severe, typically with flaring/toxic signs; Heat is more diffuse and comparatively milder.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 此卡為實火;陰虛所致者為虛火(陰虛火旺),兩者皆有紅赤之象,但實火起病急、脈洪數有力,虛火起病緩、脈細數無力兼潮熱盜汗。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: This card is excess fire; fire from Yin Deficiency is deficiency-fire (Yin Deficiency with Effulgent Fire) -- both show redness, but excess fire is acute with a forceful surging-rapid pulse, while deficiency fire is gradual with a thin-rapid forceless pulse plus tidal fever and night sweats.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Drain fire
records.point_rationale_zh: 曲池瀉熱;勞宮清心火;行間瀉肝火,依所在臟腑選穴。
records.point_rationale_en: LI11 drains heat; PC8 clears Heart fire; LR2 drains Liver fire -- points are selected by the organ involved.

key_signs_en: Fever that does not spike clearly (lingering low fever)
Bitter, sticky taste in the mouth
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with a greasy yellow coating
records.mechanism_zh: 濕與熱相合,如油入麵,膠著難解,阻遏氣機升降。為病因辨證上位分類,臨床常再定位為肝膽濕熱、脾胃濕熱、下焦濕熱等(見各下位卡)。
records.mechanism_en: Dampness and heat combine like oil mixed into flour -- tightly bound and hard to separate, obstructing the movement of qi. A category-level node in etiological pattern differentiation; clinically usually further localized as Liver-Gallbladder, Spleen-Stomach, or Lower-Jiao Damp-Heat etc. (see individual cards).
records.common_causes_zh: 外感濕熱之邪、飲食肥甘厚膩釀濕化熱、脾失健運濕邪內生鬱久化熱、久居潮濕炎熱之地
records.common_causes_en: Invasion by an exterior damp-heat pathogen, rich/greasy food generating damp that transforms into heat, Spleen dysfunction generating internal dampness that stagnates into heat, long residence in a hot, humid climate
records.progression_zh: 濕熱蘊結可依部位傳變為肝膽濕熱、脾胃濕熱、下焦濕熱、大腸濕熱等;濕熱久羈可傷陰,形成濕熱傷陰的虛實夾雜證。
records.progression_en: Damp-Heat accumulation can localize by site into Liver-Gallbladder, Spleen-Stomach, Lower-Jiao, or Large-Intestine Damp-Heat etc.; prolonged Damp-Heat can injure yin, producing a mixed deficiency-excess pattern.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 濕熱以身重、脘痞、苔黃膩、小便黃赤為主,病邪彌散;痰證以咳痰、喉間痰核、脈滑為主,病邪凝聚成形。二者可相兼(痰熱)。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Damp-Heat centers on heaviness, epigastric fullness, a greasy-yellow coating, and dark urine -- a diffuse pathogen; Phlegm centers on coughing up sputum, throat lumps, and a slippery pulse -- a pathogen condensed into a substantial form. The two can combine (Phlegm-Heat).
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 熱證單純見發熱、口渴、脈數,無苔膩、頭身困重、胸悶脘痞等濕象;濕熱兼有濕邪重濁黏滯的特徵。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heat alone shows fever, thirst, and a rapid pulse without the dampness signs of a greasy coating, heavy body, or chest/epigastric fullness; Damp-Heat additionally carries dampness's heavy, turbid, sticky character.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heat and disinhibit dampness
records.point_rationale_zh: 陰陵泉清利濕熱;三陰交健脾化濕;足三里助脾胃運化以絕生濕之源。
records.point_rationale_en: SP9 clears and disinhibits damp-heat; SP6 strengthens the Spleen and transforms dampness; ST36 supports Spleen-Stomach transformation to cut off the source of dampness.

key_signs_en: Throat lumps or numbness of the limbs
records.tongue_en: Greasy tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 津液代謝失常,凝聚成痰,隨氣升降流竄全身,可停於肺、胃、經絡、清竅等處而見不同兼證。為上位分類,臨床常再定位為痰濕阻肺、痰迷心竅等(見各下位卡)。
records.mechanism_en: Disordered fluid metabolism condenses into phlegm, which follows qi's rise and fall to travel throughout the body, lodging in the Lung, Stomach, channels, or sensory orifices with different accompanying signs. A category-level node; clinically further localized as Phlegm-Damp Obstructing the Lung, Phlegm Misting the Mind's Portals etc. (see individual cards).
records.common_causes_zh: 脾失健運水濕不化、肺失宣降津液停聚、腎陽不足氣化失司、飲食失節嗜食肥甘
records.common_causes_en: Spleen dysfunction failing to transform water-damp, Lung's loss of dispersing-descending causing fluid stagnation, insufficient Kidney yang impairing qi transformation, unregulated diet with excess rich food
records.progression_zh: 痰阻氣機可致痰氣互結(梅核氣);痰鬱化熱成痰熱;痰蒙清竅可致神昏、癲癇;痰瘀互結可成癥積。
records.progression_en: Phlegm obstructing qi movement can become Phlegm-Qi Binding (plum-pit qi); phlegm stagnation can transform into Phlegm-Heat; phlegm misting the sensory orifices can cause loss of consciousness or epilepsy; phlegm combined with stasis can form masses.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰為津液凝聚成形之邪,質稠,可隨氣流竄至喉間、經絡、清竅;濕熱為瀰漫彌散之邪,以身重、苔膩、小便黃赤為主,無成形痰核。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm is a condensed, substantial pathogen (thick in quality) that can travel to the throat, channels, or sensory orifices; Damp-Heat is a diffuse pathogen marked by heaviness, a greasy coating, and dark urine, without a formed phlegm-lump.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰以咳吐痰涎、苔膩脈滑為主,是有形之邪;氣滯(以肝氣鬱結為代表)以脹悶竄痛、脈弦為主,是無形氣機不暢,兩者常互為因果(氣滯生痰、痰阻氣機)。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm is marked by coughing up sputum, a greasy coating, and a slippery pulse -- a substantial pathogen; Qi Stagnation (represented by Liver Qi Stagnation) is marked by distension, oppression, and wandering pain with a wiry pulse -- an intangible blockage of qi movement. The two often cause each other.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Transform phlegm
records.point_rationale_zh: 豐隆為化痰要穴;陰陵泉健脾利濕絕痰源;中脘理氣和胃助運化。
records.point_rationale_en: ST40 is the key point for transforming phlegm; SP9 strengthens the Spleen and drains dampness to cut off phlegm's source; CV12 regulates qi and harmonizes the Stomach to aid transformation.

key_signs_zh: 肢體遊走性疼痛或皮膚瘙癢
key_signs_en: Wandering limb pain or itchy skin
records.tongue_en: Thin white tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 風邪輕揚開泄、善行數變,客於肌表或經絡,腠理疏鬆而汗出惡風。為病因辨證上位分類,常與寒、熱、濕邪相兼(風寒、風熱、風濕),單純外風少見,臨床多見其兼夾證(見各下位卡)。
records.mechanism_en: Wind is light, floating, and dispersing, and changes rapidly; it lodges in the exterior or the channels, loosening the pores and causing sweating with aversion to wind. A category-level node in etiological differentiation; wind rarely presents alone and is usually combined with cold, heat, or dampness (Wind-Cold, Wind-Heat, Wind-Damp etc.; see individual cards).
records.common_causes_zh: 外感風邪,常兼夾寒、熱、濕邪同時侵襲肌表或經絡
records.common_causes_en: Invasion by an exterior wind pathogen, usually combined with cold, heat, or dampness attacking the exterior or channels simultaneously
records.progression_zh: 外風可與寒濕熱相合為風寒、風熱、風濕表證;風邪不解可由表入裡,或引動內風。
records.progression_en: External Wind can combine with cold, dampness, or heat to form Wind-Cold, Wind-Heat, or Wind-Damp exterior patterns; unresolved wind can move from the exterior to the interior, or stir internal wind.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 本卡(外風)是不分兼夾的總綱;風寒犯肺是外風兼寒邪、侵犯肺系的具體證型,兼見惡寒重、無汗、脈浮緊。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: This card is the un-combined general category; Wind-Cold Invading the Lung is external wind combined with cold specifically attacking the Lung system, adding pronounced chills, no sweating, and a floating tight pulse.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 外風有惡風發熱等表證,脈浮;內風(以肝風內動為代表)無表證,以眩暈、震顫、抽搐、麻木為主,多屬內傷雜病。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: External Wind shows exterior signs (aversion to wind, fever) with a floating pulse; Internal Wind (represented by Liver Wind Stirring) shows no exterior signs and centers on dizziness, tremor, convulsion, or numbness -- an internal-damage pattern.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Disperse wind and release the exterior
records.point_rationale_zh: 風池為祛風要穴;合谷解表;風門疏散風邪。
records.point_rationale_en: GB20 is the key point for dispelling wind; LI4 releases the exterior; BL12 (Wind Gate) disperses wind.

key_signs_en: Sore, weak lower back and knees
records.mechanism_zh: 腎為先天之本,藏精、主水、主納氣、主骨生髓。腎虛則精氣不足,可偏於陰、陽、氣、精之虛而見不同兼證(腎陰虛偏熱、腎陽虛偏寒、腎氣虛以固攝無力為主、腎精虧虛以生長生殖遲緩早衰為主)。本卡舌脈刻意留空——腎陰虛與腎陽虛的舌脈方向相反(前者舌紅少苔脈細數,後者舌淡胖脈沉遲),寫死一種舌脈會誤導臨床辨證,須先辨陰陽氣精再定舌脈與治法(見各下位卡)。
records.mechanism_en: The Kidney is the congenital root, storing essence, governing water, receiving qi, and generating marrow/bone. Kidney Deficiency can lean toward yin, yang, qi, or essence deficiency, each with a different presentation (Kidney Yin Deficiency runs hot, Kidney Yang Deficiency runs cold, Kidney Qi Deficiency centers on failure to contain, Kidney Essence Deficiency centers on delayed growth/reproduction or premature aging). This card deliberately leaves tongue/pulse blank -- Kidney Yin and Kidney Yang Deficiency have opposite tongue/pulse directions (red tongue with scant coating and thin-rapid pulse vs. pale swollen tongue and deep-slow pulse); fixing one would mislead diagnosis. Yin/yang/qi/essence must be differentiated first (see individual cards).
records.common_causes_zh: 稟賦不足、房勞過度、久病傷腎、年老腎氣自衰
records.common_causes_en: Congenital insufficiency, excessive sexual activity, chronic illness injuring the Kidney, natural decline of Kidney qi with age
records.progression_zh: 腎虛日久可陰陽俱虛(腎陰陽兩虛);可累及他臟成脾腎陽虛、肝腎陰虛、心腎不交等。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Kidney Deficiency can become combined Yin-Yang Deficiency; it can also involve other organs, becoming Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency, Liver-Kidney Yin Deficiency, or Heart-Kidney Disharmony.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎陰虛在本卡共有表現外,兼見五心煩熱、顴紅盜汗、舌紅少苔、脈細數,屬虛熱一系。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Yin Deficiency adds, on top of this card's shared signs, five-center heat, malar flushing, night sweats, a red tongue with scant coating, and a thin-rapid pulse -- the deficiency-heat branch.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎陽虛在本卡共有表現外,兼見畏寒肢冷、面色㿠白、舌淡胖、脈沉遲,屬虛寒一系,與腎陰虛寒熱屬性相反。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Yang Deficiency adds chills, cold limbs, a pale/bright-white complexion, a pale swollen tongue, and a deep-slow pulse -- the deficiency-cold branch, thermally opposite to Kidney Yin Deficiency.
differential_patterns.source: 中醫診斷學 教材通用(證候鑑別章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_zh: 補腎(依偏陰、陽、氣、精選滋陰、溫陽、益氣、填精之法,見各下位卡)
records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify the Kidney (the specific method -- nourish yin, warm yang, boost qi, or fill essence -- depends on which aspect is deficient; see individual cards)
records.point_rationale_zh: 太谿為腎經原穴,腎俞、關元補益腎氣,通治各型腎虛的基礎配穴,具體方藥須依下位證型選用。
records.point_rationale_en: KI3 is the Kidney channel's Yuan-Source point; BL23 and CV4 tonify Kidney qi -- a base point set usable across Kidney Deficiency subtypes, while the formula must be chosen per the specific subtype.
sources: 中醫基礎理論 教材通用(氣血津液辨證/八綱辨證/病因辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with a thin white coating
records.mechanism_zh: 太陽主一身之表,風邪傷衛,衛陽浮盛於外故發熱,衛強營弱、營陰不能內守故汗出,汗出腠理疏故惡風。
records.mechanism_en: Tai Yang governs the body's exterior; wind injures the defensive (Wei) qi, which floats outward causing fever; Wei is strong while Ying (nutritive) qi is weak and cannot hold fluids inward, causing sweating, which loosens the pores and produces aversion to wind.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感風邪,腠理疏鬆之體質者尤易罹患
records.common_causes_en: Invasion by an exterior wind pathogen, especially in a person with loose exterior/pores
records.progression_zh: 太陽中風失治可傳入陽明或少陽;風邪日久可與寒濕相合。
records.progression_en: If untreated, Tai Yang Wind-Strike can transmit into Yang Ming or Shao Yang; wind can combine with cold or dampness over time.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 太陽中風有汗、脈浮緩,衛強營弱;太陽傷寒無汗、脈浮緊,衛閉營鬱。同屬太陽表證但汗之有無、脈之緩緊截然不同,治法一為解肌(桂枝湯)一為發汗(麻黃湯)。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Tai Yang Wind-Strike has sweating with a floating-moderate pulse (strong Wei, weak Ying); Tai Yang Cold-Damage has no sweating with a floating-tight pulse (Wei sealed, Ying stagnant). Both are Tai Yang exterior patterns but differ sharply in sweating and pulse quality; treatment differs (release the muscle layer vs. induce sweating).
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 兩者舌象相近,鑑別重點在汗與脈而非舌
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 太陽中風為傷寒六經體系的風寒表虛證,惡寒明顯,發熱較輕;衛分風熱為溫病衛氣營血體系的風熱表證,發熱明顯重於惡寒,兼咽紅腫痛、口渴,兩者所屬辨證體系與病邪性質皆不同。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Tai Yang Wind-Strike is a Wind-Cold exterior-deficiency pattern in the Six-Channel system with pronounced aversion to cold and mild fever; Wei-Stage Wind-Heat is a Wind-Heat exterior pattern in the Four-Levels system with fever more pronounced than chills, plus a red sore throat and thirst -- different systems and different pathogen natures.
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Release the muscle layer, dispel wind, and harmonize Ying and Wei
records.point_rationale_zh: 大椎、風池祛風解表;外關通陽維、助解表;合谷發汗解表力較輕,與桂枝湯解肌之法相應。
records.point_rationale_en: GV14 and GB20 dispel wind and release the exterior; SJ5 (Wai Guan) connects to the Yang Wei vessel and assists exterior release; LI4 offers a milder exterior-releasing action matching Gui Zhi Tang's gentle muscle-layer approach.
sources: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with a thin white coating
records.mechanism_zh: 寒邪外束肌表,衛陽被遏,腠理閉塞故無汗而惡寒甚;寒性收引凝滯,經脈氣血運行不暢故頭身疼痛;肺合皮毛,表閉肺氣不宣則氣喘。
records.mechanism_en: Cold binds the exterior, obstructing defensive yang; the pores close, producing no sweating with pronounced chills; cold's contracting nature impedes qi and blood flow in the channels, causing headache and body pain; since the Lung corresponds to the skin, exterior closure impairs Lung qi's dispersal, causing wheezing.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感寒邪,腠理緻密之體質者感邪後衛陽被遏更甚
records.common_causes_en: Invasion by an exterior cold pathogen, more pronounced in a person with tight, dense pores where defensive yang is more severely obstructed
records.progression_zh: 太陽傷寒失治可內傳陽明化熱成腑實,或內傳少陰成虛寒重症(素體陽虛者)。
records.progression_en: If untreated, Tai Yang Cold-Damage can transmit into Yang Ming and transform into heat/Fu-organ excess, or into Shao Yin as a severe deficiency-cold pattern in a constitutionally yang-deficient person.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 見太陽中風卡。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: See the Tai Yang Wind-Strike card.
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 太陽傷寒雖惡寒但為表閉之實證,脈浮緊有力,精神尚可;少陰寒化為裡虛寒重證,脈微細,但欲寐、精神萎靡,無頭身疼痛等表證,兩者虛實表裡截然不同,誤汗少陰病可致亡陽。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Tai Yang Cold-Damage, though chilled, is an exterior-excess pattern with a floating tight forceful pulse and preserved mental clarity; Shao Yin Cold Transformation is a severe interior deficiency-cold pattern with a faint-thin pulse, lethargy, and no exterior body-pain signs -- opposite in excess/deficiency and exterior/interior. Mistakenly inducing sweating in Shao Yin disease can cause yang collapse.
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Induce sweating with warm-acrid herbs, disperse the Lung and calm wheezing
records.point_rationale_zh: 大椎、風門發汗解表;列缺宣肺利氣;合谷助解表發汗。
records.point_rationale_en: GV14 and BL12 induce sweating and release the exterior; LU7 disperses the Lung and moves qi; LI4 assists exterior release and sweating.
sources: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

key_signs_en: Intense thirst with preference for cold drinks
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with a dry yellow coating
records.mechanism_zh: 邪熱亢盛,充斥陽明經脈而未與腸中糟粕相結,熱迫津液外泄故大汗,熱盛傷津故大渴引飲(仲景「四大證」:大熱、大汗、大渴、脈洪大)。
records.mechanism_en: Intense pathogenic heat fills the Yang Ming channel without yet binding with stool in the intestines; heat forces fluids outward causing profuse sweating; heat injures fluids causing intense thirst (Zhang Zhongjing's classic "four greats": great heat, great sweating, great thirst, a great/surging pulse).
records.common_causes_zh: 太陽表邪不解,內傳陽明化熱;或溫熱之邪直入氣分
records.common_causes_en: Unresolved Tai Yang exterior pathogen transmitting inward and transforming into Yang Ming heat; or a warm-heat pathogen entering the Qi level directly
records.progression_zh: 陽明經證熱與腸中糟粕相結,轉為陽明腑證;熱盛動血動風則傳入營血分。
records.progression_en: Yang Ming Channel Heat can bind with intestinal stool and become Yang Ming Fu-Organ Excess; extreme heat forcing blood or generating wind can transmit into the Ying/Xue levels.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 陽明經證是無形熱盛,腹部不硬滿拒按,大便不一定閉結;陽明腑證是熱與燥屎互結成有形之實,腹滿硬痛拒按、大便秘結或潮熱譫語。Yang Ming Jing 不是 Yang Ming Fu 的別名——兩者病機層次不同(V2-D 鎖定)。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Yang Ming Channel Heat is formless heat excess without a hard, tender abdomen and not necessarily constipated; Yang Ming Fu-Organ Excess is heat bound with dry stool into a tangible mass, with a hard tender distended abdomen and constipation or tidal fever with delirium. Yang Ming Jing is NOT an alias of Yang Ming Fu (V2-D Lock).
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 陽明經證(傷寒六經體系)與氣分熱(溫病衛氣營血體系)臨床表現相近、同可用白虎湯,但辨證體系與傳變脈絡不同:前者按六經傳變論治,後者按衛氣營血淺深傳變論治。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Yang Ming Channel Heat (Six-Channel system) and Qi-Stage Heat (Four-Levels system) present similarly and both may use Bai Hu Tang, but belong to different systems with different transmission logic: the former follows Six-Channel progression, the latter follows Wei-Qi-Ying-Xue depth progression.
differential_patterns.source: 溫病學 教材通用(衛氣營血辨證/三焦辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heat and generate fluids (acrid-cold to clear the Qi level)
records.point_rationale_zh: 曲池、內庭清瀉陽明經熱;大椎助清熱瀉火。
records.point_rationale_en: LI11 and ST44 clear and drain Yang Ming channel heat; GV14 assists in clearing heat and draining fire.
sources: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

key_signs_en: Tidal fever worse in late afternoon
Hard, painful, distended abdomen worse with pressure
Constipation, or paradoxical watery discharge around retained stool
records.tongue_zh: 舌紅苔黃厚而燥,甚則焦黑起刺
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with a thick, dry yellow coating, in severe cases scorched black with prickles
records.mechanism_zh: 邪熱與腸中糟粕互結成燥屎,腑氣壅滯不通,熱盛神明被擾則譫語,日晡為陽明經氣旺時,正邪相爭故潮熱加重。
records.mechanism_en: Pathogenic heat binds with intestinal stool into a dry mass, obstructing the Fu-organ's qi; heat disturbs the mind causing delirium; late afternoon is when Yang Ming channel qi is most active, so the tidal fever worsens as correct and pathogenic qi contend.
records.common_causes_zh: 陽明經證熱盛傷津,腸道失潤,燥屎內結;或素體陽盛,誤用溫燥助熱成實
records.common_causes_en: Yang Ming Channel Heat injuring fluids and drying the intestines, binding into dry stool; or a constitutionally yang-excess person given warming-drying treatment in error, hardening into an excess pattern
records.progression_zh: 燥屎不下,熱毒內熾可致熱閉心包、神昏;久延傷陰可致陰竭陽脫。
records.progression_en: If the dry stool is not expelled, heat-toxin can block the Pericardium causing loss of consciousness; prolonged course injuring yin can lead to yin exhaustion and yang collapse.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 見陽明經證卡。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: See the Yang Ming Channel Heat card.
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 陽明腑證譫語因腸腑燥屎與熱互結、腑氣不通所致,兼腹滿硬痛拒按等腑實見證,攻下燥屎後神志可轉清;熱入心包神昏是熱邪直接內陷心包所致,無腹實見證,攻下無效,須清心開竅。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Yang Ming Fu-Organ delirium arises from heat bound with dry stool obstructing the bowel, accompanied by a hard, tender, distended abdomen; clearing the stool can restore clarity. Heat Entering the Pericardium causes unconsciousness through heat directly invading the Pericardium with no bowel-excess signs; purgation does not help -- it requires clearing heat and opening the orifices.
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_zh: 峻下熱結(依燥實輕重分大/小/調胃承氣湯)
records.treatment_principle_en: Vigorously purge heat-bound stool (Da/Xiao/Tiao Wei Cheng Qi Tang graded by severity)
records.point_rationale_zh: 天樞、上巨虛通調腸腑、瀉下燥結;大橫助行氣通便。
records.point_rationale_en: ST25 and ST37 regulate the bowel and purge the bound stool; SP15 assists in moving qi to relieve constipation.
sources: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

key_signs_en: Distressing fullness of the chest and hypochondria
Vexation with a tendency to vomit
records.tongue_en: Thin white or thin yellow tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 邪在半表半裡,少陽樞機不利,正邪相爭於表裡之間故往來寒熱;膽經循脅肋,邪郁少陽經氣不暢故胸脅苦滿;膽火上炎則口苦目眩。
records.mechanism_en: The pathogen lodges between the exterior and interior; Shao Yang's pivoting function is impaired, and correct/pathogenic qi contend at that boundary, producing alternating chills and fever; the Gallbladder channel traverses the flanks, so obstructed Shao Yang qi causes chest and hypochondriac fullness; Gallbladder fire flaring upward causes a bitter taste and dizziness.
records.common_causes_zh: 太陽病失治或誤治,邪不從表解,內傳少陽,正氣稍虛不能全部驅邪外出
records.common_causes_en: Untreated or mismanaged Tai Yang disease where the pathogen fails to resolve at the exterior and transmits into Shao Yang, with correct qi slightly weakened and unable to fully expel the pathogen
records.progression_zh: 少陽證治不當可內傳陽明(少陽陽明合病),或誤下傷正內陷太陰。
records.progression_en: Mismanaged Shao Yang disease can transmit into Yang Ming, or improper purgation can injure correct qi and drive the pathogen into Tai Yin.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 太陽病純屬表證,惡寒發熱同時並見,脈浮;少陽證邪在半表半裡,寒熱交替而非同見,脈弦不浮,兼胸脅苦滿等半表半裡特有見證。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Tai Yang disease is a pure exterior pattern with simultaneous chills and fever and a floating pulse; Shao Yang alternates chills and fever (not simultaneous) with a wiry, non-floating pulse, plus the characteristic chest/flank fullness of the half-exterior-half-interior stage.
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 少陽證病勢相對表淺,可和解而愈;厥陰寒熱錯雜病及臟腑陰陽根本,上熱下寒同時並見(而非往來),兼消渴、氣上撞心、食則吐蛔等更深重見證,病勢更深。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Shao Yang is relatively shallow and resolves with harmonizing treatment; Jue Yin Mixed Cold-Heat reaches the root yin-yang of the organs, with simultaneous (not alternating) upper heat and lower cold, plus more severe signs like intense thirst, qi rushing to the chest, and vomiting after eating -- a deeper-stage pattern.
differential_patterns.source: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)

records.treatment_principle_en: Harmonize Shao Yang
records.point_rationale_zh: 足臨泣、外關為少陽經八脈交會配穴,和解樞機;陽陵泉為膽經合穴、筋會,疏泄少陽經氣。
records.point_rationale_en: GB41 and SJ5 form the Shao Yang confluent-point pair, harmonizing the pivot; GB34, the Gallbladder channel's He-Sea point and the Hui-Meeting point of sinews, disperses Shao Yang channel qi.
sources: 傷寒論/傷寒學 教材通用(六經辨證章節,課程層級引用)
